remaining_gaps: Root host integration and combined-source revalidation are not part of this isolated package.
No font chooser UI, mobile acceptance, or face enumeration/all-faces import.
Process termination recovery is measured; power loss, filesystem/controller persistence, network shares and malicious same-account directory mutation are not accepted.
The host must provide a dedicated private local directory, preserve the lock namespace, serialize handle lifetimes and destroy SDK layouts/pagers before lease release.
64 KiB is the copy-buffer bound, not total memory: SDK font creation copies encoded bytes and owns further decoded/cache allocations.

The verifier-summary artifact itself is recorded from GitHub upload/API metadata; the same job cannot self-authenticate its own later upload. The three upstream desktop ZIPs were independently downloaded and recomputed in Actions.
validation_location: All builds, tests, syntax checks, materials and artifact processing occurred in GitHub Actions. Local work was source/document editing, Git, and read-only GitHub metadata/logs.
